PP1 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND completely.
   C. Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.

2. About Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND completely.
   C. Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.

3. About Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND completely.
   C. Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND.

5. About Love of God and at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Love of God and using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Love of God and completely.
   C. Love of God and is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love of God and.

6. About Love of God and at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Love of God and at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Love of God and completely.
   C. Love of God and is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love of God and.

7. About Love of God and when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Love of God and helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Love of God and completely.
   C. Love of God and is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love of God and.

9. About Church as a place at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Church as a place using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a place completely.
   C. Church as a place is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a place.

10. About Church as a place at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Church as a place at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a place completely.
   C. Church as a place is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a place.

11. About Church as a place when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Church as a place helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a place completely.
   C. Church as a place is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a place.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Christian rituals RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Love of God and at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Church as a place at home with your family.
